metadata.title: FarmXpert — AI-Powered Agriculture Platform
metadata.description: Multi-agent AI for precision agriculture: soil health, irrigation, pest detection, yield prediction and live market intelligence — running on every field, every season.
metadata.ogDescription: Eight specialized AI agents working as one. Built for real farms and real margins.

hero.description: Multi-agent AI systems monitor soil health, predict yields, detect disease, and forecast market prices in real-time — turning every field into a data-driven operation.

agents.intro: Each agent is a specialized ML model, trained on millions of agricultural data points and working in concert to give holistic farm intelligence.

features.intro: From root to revenue — FarmXpert's layered AI architecture monitors everything that affects your yield and profitability.

multiAgent.title: Multi-Agent Collaboration
multiAgent.description: Agents communicate asynchronously to produce compound recommendations — for example, irrigation schedules that factor in pest stress and forecasted rain simultaneously.

edgeAnalytics.title: Real-Time Edge Analytics
edgeAnalytics.description: Sub-200ms latency analytics via edge-deployed TensorFlow Lite models, even in low-connectivity rural areas with intermittent internet.

satelliteFusion.title: Satellite + IoT Fusion
satelliteFusion.description: Sentinel-2 satellite bands fused with on-field sensor telemetry for ground-truth accuracy at every spatial scale from 10m² to 1000 hectares.

adaptiveLoop.title: Adaptive Learning Loop
adaptiveLoop.description: Models retrain monthly on your farm's actual outcomes — yield data, treatment results, weather events — continuously improving recommendation precision.

howItWorks.intro: FarmXpert's pipeline transforms raw sensor readings into actionable decisions in under 200 milliseconds.

ingestion.title: Data Ingestion
ingestion.description: IoT sensors, drones, satellite feeds, and weather APIs stream live data to the FarmXpert edge gateway continuously.

analysis.title: Agent Analysis
analysis.description: Specialized AI agents process relevant data streams in parallel using CNN, LSTM, and transformer models optimized for agriculture.

fusion.title: Multi-Agent Fusion
fusion.description: Orchestration layer combines insights from all agents, resolves conflicts, and weights recommendations by confidence scores.

action.title: Smart Action
action.description: Recommendations delivered via app, voice, or direct actuator control — automated irrigation, alerts, task assignments, and reports.

tech.intro: Enterprise-grade ML pipelines, scalable microservices, and production-ready AI — built for the demands of precision agriculture at scale.

chipScene.intro: FarmXpert's multi-agent processor — sixteen specialized AI modules on a single intelligent substrate, routing real-time farm intelligence at sub-200ms latency.

cta.intro: Join 12,000+ farmers already using FarmXpert to optimize every acre. Setup takes under 10 minutes — no hardware required to start.

onboarding.railLead: Six short steps. Every answer makes the advice fit your land better.

you.title: First, a little
you.lead: So FarmXpert can greet you, and answer in the language you think in.
you.why: Your language decides how every answer, text or voice, is written and spoken.

farm.title: Where is
farm.lead: Standing on your field? Tap "Use my location" - it is the most accurate.
farm.why: The exact location fetches your weather forecast, the rain and heat warnings, and the nearest mandi prices. Area sets how much water and fertiliser is needed.

crop.title: What are you
crop.lead: The crop in the field today, and the soil it grows in.
crop.why: Crop, stage and sowing date drive the irrigation schedule and the day-by-day work plan. Soil type decides how fast water drains and how much the soil holds.

soil.title: Do you have a
soil.lead: A Soil Health Card or a lab report makes fertiliser advice exact. No report? Skip this - we will use your soil type.
soil.why: pH and N-P-K levels decide which fertiliser, how much, and whether the soil needs lime or gypsum.

resources.title: What you have
resources.lead: Workers, machines and money - so the plan only asks for what you can actually do.
resources.why: The task planner schedules jobs within your people, equipment, budget and working hours.

device.title: Connect a
device.lead: Have a Blynk soil probe? Connect it for live moisture and nutrient readings. No sensor? Skip - you can add one later.
device.why: Live readings let irrigation advice follow the soil as it dries, instead of estimating.
